offer.text: It's getting late and the road isn't safe alone. Keep close and keep the monsters off me, and I'll lead us back to the village before nightfall.

accept.text: Stay near — I'll set the pace.

decline.text: Then I'll risk the road myself, I suppose.

in_progress.text: Keep moving with me, friend — we haven't long before dusk.

ready.text: Home at last, and before dark! I knew I could trust you.

complete.text: Safe and sound. I won't forget this kindness.

failed.text: Night fell before we made it. We were lucky to survive — maybe next time.
